title: The Best Justin Bieber Merch on Amazon from ‘My World 2.0’ Throwback Tees to Cozy ‘Changes’ Hoodies
summary: We've compiled the best official items from his Amazon merch shop.
contentText:
Justin Bieber is having a major moment, and the year has only just begun.

Hot off his main stage performance at Coachella 2026, the “Dasies” singer is all that seems to be on anyone’s minds, non-Beliebers included. The musician’s debut performance at the festival ignited a resurgance, reminding everyone that Bieber deserves all the hype he’s received, even when he’s not actively in the spotlight. Now in May, that Bieber fever hasn’t slowed down, only ramping up on the Billboard charts.

The singer’s hit “Beauty and a Beat,” featuring  Nicki Minaj , is currently one of the biggest songs in the world, rising a spot to No. 1 on the  Billboard Global 200  and spending a second week atop the  Billboard Global Excl. U.S.  chart. That is despite the fact that the song is almost 14 years old. In fact, many of Bieber’s songs have begun to garner more streams since his set, including “Everything Hallelujah,” which took the number six spot on  Billboard ’s  Hot Christian Songs  chart.

With Bieber mania alive and well, we’ve decided to compile a few of our favorite pieces of merch from the singer’s official Amazon Music storefront. Our list includes cozy crewnecks, graphic tees with throwback art, Changes era pop sockets and everything in between. Keep reading below to shop our favorites.

The Best Justin Bieber Merch on Amazon

Justin Bieber Changes Pullover Hoodie

$49.99

Buy Now On Amazon

This is a black hoodie from Justin Bieber’s Changes era. The album was released back in 2020.

Justin Bieber’s Changes era was a moment that likely saved most people from depressive episodes back in 2020. The album debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 chart (dated Feb. 29, 2020), earning 231,000 equivalent album units in its first week. This hoodie captures the magic of music at that time, featuring the album’s artwork in gray on a black background with white lettering surrounding it. This is an oversized style, great for cozying up on those lazy days where putting on an outfit seems like work.

Official Justin Bieber Peaches White Tote Bag 16 inches

$21.99

This is a white tote making reference to Justin Bieber’s hit track “Peaches” from 2021. The tote is white with peachy pink graphics.

“Peaches” was a major hit for Bieber on the Billboard charts. The track claimed the number one spot on the Hot 100 charts (dated April 3, 2021) and stayed on the charts for a whopping 30 weeks. The singer has a slew of top-charting hits, but this one defined summer 2021. With that in mind, this “Peaches” inspired tote from Amazon is a cute addition to any bag rotation. It’s a reminder of that summer when the song was everywhere. The tote is spacious enough at 16 inches to hold a laptop and features cute peach graphics on the front.

Justin Bieber Black Stand for Smartphones and Tablets PopSockets MagSafe PopGrip for iPhone

$28.99

PopSockets like these can be used to prop up your phone or hold said phone more comfortably. This PopSocket has Bieber’s logo on it from his Changes era.

PopSockets are a practical item for holding your phone up while watching videos hands-free. They also make holding your phone a lot easier. Practicality aside, this accessory also looks pretty awesome attached to a phone. The white rocker-esque logo on the front is also from Bieber’s Changes era.

Official Justin Bieber My World 2.0 White T-Shirt

$24.99

This is a throwback tee from Justin Bieber’s My World 2.0 album. The tee is white with purple graphics.

This tee is sure a throwback, given that Bieber’s My World 2.0 was released in 2010. Yes, that’s the album with some of the singer’s most iconic hits from “Baby” to “U Smile” and “Somebody to Love.” Justin’s debut album hit number one on the Billboard 200 chart in April 2010, selling 283,000 copies in its first week. Bieber became the youngest solo male artist to top the charts at just 16 years old, passing up Stevie Wonder. This Amazon shirt features Bieber’s album cover art and that distinct Bieber bright purple splattered throughout. Since this tee is white, it can replace the basics in your wardrobe for something a little more fun.

Justin Bieber Red Circle Changes Sweatshirt

$54.99

This is another piece from Bieber’s Changes era. The crewneck is black with red graphics on the front.

Changes era had the most unique art styling, which is why Amazon features so many pieces of merch with the era splashed on it. This crewneck is black with the album artwork on the front in a contrasting bright red. This style comes in sizes small through XXL. If you run cold or you’re prepping early for fall and winter, this crewneck is certainly a cozy addition to your wardrobe, especially when layered.

Justin Bieber Official My World 2.0 Photo T-Shirt

This is yet another graphic tee from Justin Bieber’s My World 2.0 album. The tee features a cute throwback photo of Bieber on the front with purple graphics.

Bieber’s My World 2.0 album is a fan-favorite for many Beliebers, which is why Amazon also has a ton of merch from that time period . This is yet another throwback graphic tee with a cute photo of Bieber slapped onto the front. It’s more subdued than the last piece of merch we’ve spotlighted, great for those who want to dress more minimally. For the most part, this piece is monochrome, save for the subtle My World 2.0 logo detailing just below the image of the “Peaches” singer. Beyond the design, graphic tees have become extremely expensive over the years, especially older styles. That’s why we like this piece because it retails for just $24.99 .
